rationale: David brings deep expertise in shipping autonomous systems and real-time infrastructure (WebRTC, LiveKit, computer vision) from a decade leading R&D at drone and robotics companies, while JD is a builder comfortable across the stack (Python, JavaScript, Solidity) who's proven ability to ship products and automate complex systems. At a physical AI hackathon, David's production robotics mentorship and LiveKit infrastructure knowledge could directly inform how JD approaches building real-time systems, and JD's builder mindset and full-stack comfort could offer fresh perspectives on automation and tooling.
intro_message: David Chen, meet JD — David judges robotics infrastructure at LiveKit and previously shipped autonomous systems at scale; JD is a full-stack builder from the Solana ecosystem now exploring new domains, and you both think creatively about automating complex problems.
